name: Buddha Sculpture
details: A meticulously crafted 3D sculpture of Lord Buddha, designed to convey a deep sense of serenity, peace, and meditative calm. This digital replica captures the traditional artistic essence of historical stone and bronze carvings, highlighting intricate folds in the robes, serene facial expressions, and classical hand mudras. The model utilizes advanced texture mapping to replicate realistic material properties such as ancient stone wear, subtle grain textures, and realistic lighting shadows. Perfectly optimized for real-time mobile rendering, it delivers an engaging educational and spiritual visualization experience within augmented reality environments. Users can interactively explore the sculpture from 360 degrees to appreciate the subtle contours, fine lines, and historic craftsmanship. It is an ideal asset for digital museums, cultural heritage exhibitions, and mindfulness applications, ensuring fluid performance, low memory footprint, and quick streaming capabilities on the InfoScan mobile platform.
